 WELCOME TO THE PLAYGROUND

Eight rounds. One champion.

Select Whole world · 250 to automatically play 250 → 128 → 64 → 32 → 16 → 8 → 4 → 2 → champion. Each round lasts 35–50 seconds of active play, followed by a short automatic transition.

Gap exits are paced across the countdown. At the buzzer, flags closest to the center fill any remaining qualifying places. Qualifiers keep their countries in the next round.

Collisions are perfectly elastic, with no friction, air drag, speed cap, or collision damage. Gravity can change speed; moving gap edges can transfer energy. Flags keep bouncing until eliminated.

Each flag has a spring-connected particle mesh that flexes on impact. Turn on Show particle mesh to see it. Smaller lineups play a single escape battle.

The tournament pace stays at 1×. Pause also freezes the round countdown and automatic transitions. Hover or tap a flag to see its country.
